title: Mapping the AI trade boom
gist: Oxford Economics' 104-product AI export index shows an Asia-centred, intermediate-goods-heavy (~60%) AI trade boom where semiconductors are only ~34% of value; China is the largest exporter but Taiwan the most exposed, the US the largest (downstream-weighted) importer, and reliance on shared regional freight networks (air freight largest) concentrates logistics risk.

insights.claim: Oxford Economics tracks 104 AI-related traded products (semiconductors, servers, computing equipment, other inputs and capital goods) to build an AI export index measuring the trade boom from the global AI capacity build-out.
insights.speaker: Sally Li
insights.so_what: Trade data on this basket offers a real-economy gauge of AI capex momentum beyond company guidance.
insights.quote: We track 104 AI-related products, spanning semiconductors, servers, computing equipment, and other inputs and capital goods, and use them to construct an AI export index.
insights.locator: The global build-out of AI capacity

insights.claim: Semiconductors account for around 34% of AI-related trade, with the remainder spread across computers, networking equipment, power infrastructure and other inputs.
insights.speaker: Sally Li
insights.so_what: Roughly two-thirds of AI trade value sits outside chips, so beneficiaries of the build-out extend to networking, power and computer hardware suppliers.
insights.quote: Semiconductors account for around 34% of AI-related trade

insights.claim: Intermediate goods such as chips and components make up around 60% of the AI-related trade basket, showing the AI investment boom reaches far upstream into global supply chains.
insights.speaker: Sally Li
insights.so_what: Upstream component exporters carry heavy leverage to any change in AI capex, amplifying both upside and downside.
insights.quote: showing how far the AI investment boom reaches upstream into global supply chains

insights.claim: Asia sits at the centre of AI-related trade, with Asian economies playing different roles within the AI supply chain.
insights.speaker: Sally Li
insights.so_what: Asian export data and currencies are a key read-through on the AI cycle.
insights.locator: Asia sits at the centre of AI-related trade

insights.claim: China is the largest exporter of AI-related goods, but Taiwan is considerably more exposed to shifts in AI investment.
insights.speaker: Sally Li
insights.so_what: Taiwan's economy, exports and equity market are the more concentrated macro bet on AI capex, and the most vulnerable to an AI investment slowdown.
insights.quote: China is the largest exporter, while Taiwan is considerably more exposed to shifts in AI investment.
insights.locator: Asia sits at the centre of AI-related trade

insights.claim: The US is the largest importer of AI-related goods, with its import mix weighted further downstream than the rest of the supply chain.
insights.speaker: Sally Li
insights.so_what: US AI build-out depends on imported finished hardware, linking US capex to tariff and trade-policy risk.
insights.locator: Asia sits at the centre of AI-related trade

insights.claim: Air freight is the largest transport mode for AI-related trade, though freight networks differ sharply by mode (air, container and overland).
insights.speaker: Sally Li
insights.so_what: Air cargo volumes and rates are a high-frequency indicator of AI hardware trade and benefit from the build-out.
insights.quote: Air freight is the largest transport mode for AI-related trade
insights.locator: Air freight is the largest transport mode

insights.claim: Because an AI supply chain spanning several economies can still depend on a common regional freight network, freight exposure in AI trade is less diversified than the supply chain's geography suggests.
insights.speaker: Sally Li
insights.so_what: Disruption to a single regional logistics network could hit AI hardware flows from multiple countries at once, a hidden concentration risk.
insights.quote: leaving freight exposure less diversified than the geography of the supply chain might suggest
